title: ChargeRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for charging a customer. V1 records the charge as an evy.transactions row; a real payment provider will be called later.

fk.description: The marketplace item this charge moves money for.

resource.description: Resource ref of the record `fk` belongs to, e.g. marketplace.items.

currency.description: From the item's price; "AUD" in v1.

authorization_message_id.description: The buyer's original request (the message stating the price).
